config.notes: Melbourne Polytechnic course pages (www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/<level>/<course>/) carry a local and an international panel in the same HTML. Overview: Campus / Duration / Next Intake are printed twice, local first and international second; the adapter reads the second (no reading when only one is printed). Fees & Costs: local VET uses a Concession / Government subsidised / Non-subsidised table; local HE prints CSP and Fee-paying Places Per year / Per semester; the international panel is the Per year $X Per semester $Y pair followed by the fee note (The student tuition fees... / Materials fee / Total tuition / When you are studying...); per-semester and Total tuition figures are not read. Where Per year equals Per semester (6-month courses) the figure is a whole-course amount and must be excluded. IELTS is printed once under Requirements (international entry). The header line after Code / CRICOS / VTAC Number may say "Sorry, this course is not available for international students" (read into not_admitting); "no longer accepting enrolments" marks closed courses. Intakes are printed as months, so no term_months. Central: English https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/how-to-enrol/international-admissions/entrance-requirements/ ; calendars https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/students/academic-calendars/ (HE: Semester 1 Feb, Semester 2 Jul, Summer Nov; VET: Term 1 Feb, Term 2 Apr, Term 3 Jul, Term 4 Oct). 5 Oct 15:22 (exit awards and requirements): entry_requirement reads the international entry line 'Academic: <requirement> English: ...' under Requirements (pages without that line, e.g. the Master, give none). No exit_awards pattern: exits are printed by subject count or as an embedded exit (Bachelor of Information Technology: associate degree after 16 of 24 subjects; Bachelor of Engineering Technology (Civil): exit with the Associate Degree after the BET210 capstone), never as years of full-time study. No fee_total: the international panel prints Per year; whole-course amounts appear only for 6-month courses (excluded).
config.reason: Final: entry_requirement (international Academic line) for review; exit award probe removed (no years-based exits printed); no whole-course fee (Claude exit awards and requirements, on the Platform Admin instruction 5 Oct 15:22)
